commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' Bart Verbruggen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).

90+11' Two players stand over the free kick. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.

90+9' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Peter Bankes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Newcastle earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+8' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+7' Nick Pope makes a good save! Julio Enciso (Brighton) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
90+6' A goal, which was scored by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd), was disallowed due to offside.
90+5' Referee Peter Bankes sees the trip by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lewis Hall as he is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' What a chance for Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball went just wide of the right post.

90+2' What an opportunity! Mats Wieffer (Brighton) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the left side of the goal, but Nick Pope reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.

89' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Newcastle, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
86' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
85' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) replacing Anthony Gordon.
85' That will be all from Bruno Guimaraes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
85' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julio Enciso (Brighton) is cleared to safety by the defence.
85' Julio Enciso (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball is out of play and Brighton manage to earn a corner.

84' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) drives a shot towards the roof of the net from inside the box, but Nick Pope leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brighton.
82' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Yasin Ayari is replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
81' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make a change. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is unable to continue due to injury, Jan Paul van Hecke comes on.
77' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
75' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

74' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Bart Verbruggen easily makes the save.
72' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Georginio Rutter.
71' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) replaces Carlos Baleba.
71' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is booked.
69' A great run by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.

68' Excellent touch by Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
67' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) whips in a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen is well positioned and punches the ball away.
67' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) produces a killer pass onto Joelinton, who loses the ball to one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.
66' Here is a change. Sandro Tonali is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
65' Here comes a substitution. Jacob Murphy is given a rest as he is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).

64' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a great save to deny Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
64' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

63' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen was alert and the score remains the same.
61' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) coming on for Evan Ferguson.
59' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) picks out Evan Ferguson with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
57' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
57' The resulting corner from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) comes to nothing.
56' That's unlucky! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

53' Chance! Alexander Isak sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar.
52' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Nick Pope.
49' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
48' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Igor (Brighton) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
45+1' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
45' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
41' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Bart Verbruggen (Brighton).

41' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a great save to deny Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top right corner. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
37' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Georginio Rutter plays a simple square pass into the feet of Danny Welbeck (Brighton) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
33' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a great save to deny Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
31' Anthony Gordon sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Joelinton (Newcastle Utd), whose close-range header flashes just wide of the right post.
31' The referee awards a corner and Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
30' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Newcastle earn a corner.
29' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
29' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Peter Bankes stops the game and makes a call. Brighton will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
27' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) misdirects his free kick from outside the box and the ball sails well wide of the left post.
23' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Danny Welbeck (Brighton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Newcastle win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
21' A pass from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
18' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
18' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
17' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
17' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

16' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball in, but Bart Verbruggen comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) was in a good position to shoot around the penalty spot after a nice pass, but his effort was unintentionally blocked by one of his teammates.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

9' Alexander Isak nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
8' Referee Peter Bankes signals NO PENALTY for Newcastle after a VAR review!

8' Play continues despite the shouts by some Newcastle players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Peter Bankes interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
7' Joel Veltman (Brighton) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
5' A crossfield pass from Lewis Dunk (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

3' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
2' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
2' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Bart Verbruggen punches the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Newcastle will kick-off.
Peter Bankes was nominated as the referee for this game.
